####SV DEL merge

```{r}
overlapped_DEL_reads <- DEL_reads_h453 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, SV_start, SV_end_453 = SV_end, ID_h453 =ID, REF, ALT, SV_type, SV_len_h453 =SV_len ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  full_join(DEL_reads_a630 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, SV_start, SV_end_630 = SV_end, ID_a630 =ID, REF, ALT, SV_type, SV_len_a630 = SV_len )%>%
    distinct())%>%
  mutate(commonID = case_when(!is.na(ID_h453) &!is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_common"), 
                                !is.na(ID_h453) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_h453"),
                                !is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_a630, "_a630")),
         commonend = pmax(SV_end_453 ,SV_end_630, na.rm = T))


merged_DEL <-rbind(DEL_reads_h453 %>%
                     left_join(overlapped_DEL_reads %>%
                                 filter(!is.na(ID_h453)) %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_h453, commonID, commonend)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
        dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end = commonend, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod) %>%
          mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP H4-53"),
      DEL_reads_a630 %>%
        inner_join(overlapped_DEL_reads %>%
                      filter(!is.na(ID_a630))  %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_a630, commonID, commonend)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
        dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end = commonend, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod)%>%
          mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP A6-30"))%>%
  dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, read_id, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rbind(DEL_reads_uwb1_brca1 %>%
          mutate(Sample = if_else(read_type == "parent", "UWB1", "UWB1 BRCA1"),
                 ID = paste0(ID, "_U")) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, read_id, SV_end, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample)) %>%
  mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, chrom,  read_type) %>%
  filter(n()>3) %>%
  summarise(Meth = sum(mod == "Me"), read_cnts = n(),
            Unmeth = read_cnts - Meth,
            meth_perc = Meth/read_cnts) %>%
  ungroup() 

plot_DEL <- merged_DEL %>%
  filter(read_type == "parent", (meth_perc >=0.8| meth_perc <= 0.2) ) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, p_meth_perc= meth_perc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_DEL%>%
              filter(read_type == "ref")) %>%
  filter(abs(meth_perc - p_meth_perc) <=0.2) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_DEL %>%
              filter(read_type != "parent")) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  mutate( SV_len = SV_end - SV_start)%>%
  distinct()%>%
  group_by(SV_len, ID, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type)==2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  arrange(SV_len, ID, ref_position, read_type)


CpG_DEL_fisher <- plot_DEL  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, ref_position,chrom, read_type, Meth, Unmeth, SV_len) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(Meth, Unmeth),names_from = read_type)%>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position, SV_len) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p.value =fisher.test(x = matrix(c(Meth_alt, Meth_ref, Unmeth_alt, Unmeth_ref),byrow = T, nrow = 2))$p.value ) %>%
  mutate(diff = Meth_alt/(Meth_alt+Unmeth_alt) -  Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(fisher.adj = p.adjust(p.value),
         sig = (fisher.adj <= 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.8 )) %>%
  ungroup()  


plot_DEL_density <- plot_DEL%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Meth, Unmeth, read_cnts)) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = meth_perc, names_from = read_type) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  mutate(diff = alt- ref) %>%
  distinct() 

plot_DEL_density$density <-get_density(plot_DEL_density$relat_pos, plot_DEL_density$diff, n =40)


CpG_DEL_fisher %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(sig_n = sum(sig))
```

####SV INS merge

```{r}
overlapped_INS_reads <- INS_reads_h453 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, SV_start, SV_end_453 = SV_end, ID_h453 =ID, REF, SV_type, SV_len_h453 =SV_len ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  full_join(INS_reads_a630 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, SV_start, SV_end_630 = SV_end, ID_a630 =ID, REF, SV_type, SV_len_a630 = SV_len )%>%
    distinct())%>%
  mutate(commonID = case_when(!is.na(ID_h453) &!is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_common"), 
                                !is.na(ID_h453) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_h453"),
                                !is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_a630, "_a630")),
         commonend = pmax(SV_end_453 ,SV_end_630, na.rm = T),
         commonSV_len = pmax(SV_len_h453 ,SV_len_a630 , na.rm = T ))

merged_INS <-rbind(INS_reads_h453 %>% 
                     left_join(overlapped_INS_reads %>%
                                 filter(!is.na(ID_h453)) %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_h453, commonID, commonend, commonSV_len)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
        dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end = commonend, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, SV_len= commonSV_len) %>%
          mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP H4-53"),
      INS_reads_a630 %>%
        inner_join(overlapped_INS_reads %>%
                      filter(!is.na(ID_a630))  %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_a630, commonID, commonend, commonSV_len)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
        dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end = commonend, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, SV_len =commonSV_len )%>%
          mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP A6-30"))%>%
  dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, read_id, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample, SV_len) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rbind(INS_reads_uwb1_brca1 %>%
          mutate(Sample = if_else(read_type == "parent", "UWB1", "UWB1 BRCA1"),
                 ID = paste0(ID, "_U")) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, read_id, SV_end, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample, SV_len)) %>%
  mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, chrom,  read_type, SV_len) %>%
  filter(n()>3) %>%
  summarise(Meth = sum(mod == "Me"), read_cnts = n(),
            Unmeth = read_cnts - Meth,
            meth_perc = Meth/read_cnts) %>%
  ungroup() 

plot_INS <- merged_INS %>%
  filter(read_type == "parent", (meth_perc >=0.8| meth_perc <= 0.2) ) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, p_meth_perc= meth_perc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_INS%>%
              filter(read_type == "ref")) %>%
  filter(abs(meth_perc - p_meth_perc) <=0.2) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_INS %>%
              filter(read_type != "parent")) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  distinct()%>%
  group_by(SV_len, ID, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type)==2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  arrange(SV_len, ID, ref_position, read_type)


CpG_INS_fisher <- plot_INS  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, ref_position,chrom, read_type, Meth, Unmeth, SV_len) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(Meth, Unmeth),names_from = read_type)%>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position, SV_len) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p.value =fisher.test(x = matrix(c(Meth_alt, Meth_ref, Unmeth_alt, Unmeth_ref),byrow = T, nrow = 2))$p.value ) %>%
  mutate(diff = Meth_alt/(Meth_alt+Unmeth_alt) -  Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(fisher.adj = p.adjust(p.value),
         sig = (fisher.adj <= 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.8 )) %>%
  ungroup()  


plot_INS_density <- plot_INS%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Meth, Unmeth, read_cnts)) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = meth_perc, names_from = read_type) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  mutate(diff = alt- ref) %>%
  distinct() 

plot_INS_density$density <-get_density(plot_INS_density$relat_pos, plot_INS_density$diff, n =40)
```

####SV DUP merge

```{r}
overlapped_DUP_reads <- DUP_reads_h453 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, SV_start, SV_end_453 = SV_end, ID_h453 =ID, REF, SV_type, SV_len_h453 =SV_len ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  full_join(DUP_reads_a630 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, SV_start, SV_end_630 = SV_end, ID_a630 =ID, REF, SV_type, SV_len_a630 = SV_len )%>%
    distinct())%>%
  mutate(commonID = case_when(!is.na(ID_h453) &!is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_common"), 
                                !is.na(ID_h453) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_h453"),
                                !is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_a630, "_a630")),
         commonend = pmax(SV_end_453 ,SV_end_630, na.rm = T),
         commonSV_len = pmax(SV_len_h453 ,SV_len_a630 , na.rm = T ))

merged_DUP <-rbind(DUP_reads_h453 %>% 
                     left_join(overlapped_DUP_reads %>%
                                 filter(!is.na(ID_h453)) %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_h453, commonID, commonend, commonSV_len)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
        dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end = commonend, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, SV_len= commonSV_len) %>%
          mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP H4-53"),
      DUP_reads_a630 %>%
        inner_join(overlapped_DUP_reads %>%
                      filter(!is.na(ID_a630))  %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_a630, commonID, commonend, commonSV_len)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
        dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end = commonend, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, SV_len =commonSV_len )%>%
          mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP A6-30"))%>%
  dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, read_id, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample, SV_len) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rbind(DUP_reads_uwb1_brca1 %>%
          mutate(Sample = if_else(read_type == "parent", "UWB1", "UWB1 BRCA1"),
                 ID = paste0(ID, "_U")) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, read_id, SV_end, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample, SV_len)) %>%
  mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, chrom,  read_type, SV_len) %>%
  filter(n()>3) %>%
  summarise(Meth = sum(mod == "Me"), read_cnts = n(),
            Unmeth = read_cnts - Meth,
            meth_perc = Meth/read_cnts) %>%
  ungroup() 

plot_DUP <- merged_DUP %>%
  filter(read_type == "parent", (meth_perc >=0.8| meth_perc <= 0.2) ) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, p_meth_perc= meth_perc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_DUP%>%
              filter(read_type == "ref")) %>%
  filter(abs(meth_perc - p_meth_perc) <=0.2) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_DUP %>%
              filter(read_type != "parent")) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                                ref_position > SV_start &ref_position < SV_end ~ (ref_position-SV_start)/SV_len *5000,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end +5000,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  distinct()%>%
  group_by(SV_len, ID, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type)==2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  arrange(SV_len, ID, ref_position, read_type)


CpG_DUP_fisher <- plot_DUP  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, ref_position,chrom, read_type, Meth, Unmeth, SV_len) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(Meth, Unmeth),names_from = read_type)%>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position, SV_len) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p.value =fisher.test(x = matrix(c(Meth_alt, Meth_ref, Unmeth_alt, Unmeth_ref),byrow = T, nrow = 2))$p.value ) %>%
  mutate(diff = Meth_alt/(Meth_alt+Unmeth_alt) -  Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(fisher.adj = p.adjust(p.value),
         sig = (fisher.adj <= 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.8 )) %>%
  ungroup()  


plot_DUP_density <- plot_DUP%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Meth, Unmeth, read_cnts)) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = meth_perc, names_from = read_type) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                               ref_position > SV_start &ref_position < SV_end ~ (ref_position-SV_start)/SV_len *5000,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end +5000,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  mutate(diff = alt- ref) %>%
  distinct() 


plot_DUP_density$density <-get_density(plot_DUP_density$relat_pos, plot_DUP_density$diff, n =80)
```

```{r}
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_BND%>%
              filter(read_type == "ref")) %>%
  filter(abs(meth_perc - p_meth_perc) <=0.2) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_BND %>%
              filter(read_type != "parent")) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(abs(ref_position-SV_start) <= abs(ref_position-SV_end)~ abs(ref_position -SV_start),
                               abs(ref_position-SV_start) >= abs(ref_position-SV_end) ~ abs(ref_position -SV_end),
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  distinct()%>%
  group_by( ID, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type)==2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  arrange(ID, ref_position, read_type)


CpG_BND_fisher <- plot_BND  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end, chr_end, ref_position,chrom, read_type, Meth, Unmeth) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position,chrom, read_type) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(Meth, Unmeth),names_from = read_type)%>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p.value =fisher.test(x = matrix(c(Meth_alt, Meth_ref, Unmeth_alt, Unmeth_ref),byrow = T, nrow = 2))$p.value ) %>%
  mutate(diff = Meth_alt/(Meth_alt+Unmeth_alt) -  Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(fisher.adj = p.adjust(p.value),
         sig = (fisher.adj <= 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.8 )) %>%
  ungroup()  


plot_BND_density <- plot_BND%>%
  dplyr::select(-SV_start, -SV_end, -chr_end) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Meth, Unmeth, read_cnts)) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = meth_perc, names_from = read_type) %>%
  mutate(diff = alt- ref) %>%
  distinct() 


plot_BND_density$density <-get_density(plot_BND_density$relat_pos, plot_BND_density$diff, n =40)
```

####indel DEL merge

```{r}
overlapped_indel_del_reads <- indel_del_h453 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end, ID_h453 =ID, REF, ALT, type, indel_size ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  full_join(indel_del_a630 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end, ID_a630 =ID, REF, ALT, type, indel_size)%>%
    distinct())%>%
  mutate(commonID = case_when(!is.na(ID_h453) &!is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_common"), 
                                !is.na(ID_h453) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_h453"),
                                !is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_a630, "_a630")))

merged_indel_del <-rbind(indel_del_h453 %>%
                                 left_join(overlapped_indel_del_reads %>%
                                       filter(!is.na(ID_h453)) %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_h453, commonID)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
                           dplyr::select(ID, start, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, indel_size, end) %>%
                           mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP H4-53"),
                   indel_del_a630 %>%
                           right_join(overlapped_indel_del_reads %>%
                                        filter(!is.na(ID_a630)) %>%
                                        dplyr::select(ID = ID_a630, commonID)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID)%>%
                     dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
                           dplyr::select(ID, start, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, indel_size, end)%>%
                           mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP A6-30"))%>%
  dplyr::select(ID, start, end, ref_position, indel_size, read_id, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rbind(indel_del_uwb1_brca1 %>%
          mutate(Sample = if_else(read_type == "parent", "UWB1", "UWB1 BRCA1"),
                 ID = paste0(ID, "_U")) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, start, end, ref_position, indel_size, read_id, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample)) %>%
  mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(ID, start, end, ref_position, chrom,  read_type, indel_size) %>%
  filter(n()>3) %>%
  summarise(Meth = sum(mod == "Me"), read_cnts = n(),
            Unmeth = read_cnts - Meth,
            meth_perc = Meth/read_cnts) %>%
  ungroup() 

plot_indel_del <- merged_indel_del  %>%
  filter(read_type == "parent", (meth_perc >=0.8| meth_perc <= 0.2) ) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, p_meth_perc= meth_perc, indel_size) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_indel_del%>%
              filter(read_type == "ref")) %>%
  filter(abs(meth_perc - p_meth_perc) <=0.2) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, ID, indel_size) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_indel_del %>%
              filter(read_type != "parent")) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= start ~ ref_position -start,
                               ref_position >= end ~ ref_position -end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  distinct()%>%
  group_by(indel_size, ID, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type)==2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  arrange(indel_size, ID, ref_position, read_type)


CpG_indel_del_fisher <- plot_indel_del  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, ref_position,chrom, read_type, Meth, Unmeth, indel_size) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(Meth, Unmeth),names_from = read_type)%>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position, indel_size) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p.value =fisher.test(x = matrix(c(Meth_alt, Meth_ref, Unmeth_alt, Unmeth_ref),byrow = T, nrow = 2))$p.value ) %>%
  mutate(diff = Meth_alt/(Meth_alt+Unmeth_alt) -  Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(fisher.adj = p.adjust(p.value),
         sig = (fisher.adj <= 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.8 )) %>%
  ungroup()  


plot_indel_del_density <- plot_indel_del%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Meth, Unmeth, read_cnts)) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = meth_perc, names_from = read_type) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= start ~ ref_position -start,
                               ref_position >= end ~ ref_position -end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  mutate(diff = alt- ref) %>%
  distinct() 

plot_indel_del_density$density <-get_density(plot_indel_del_density$relat_pos, plot_indel_del_density$diff, n =80)


CpG_DEL_fisher %>%
  mutate(diff_dir = diff/diff) %>%
  filter(diff >0) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(n_sig = sum(sig)) %>%
```

```{r}
overlapped_indel_ins_reads <- indel_ins_h453 %>%

  distinct() %>%
  full_join(indel_ins_a630 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end, ID_a630 =ID, REF, ALT, type, indel_size)%>%
    distinct())%>%
  mutate(commonID = case_when(!is.na(ID_h453) &!is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_common"), 
                                !is.na(ID_h453) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_h453"),
                                !is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_a630, "_a630")))

merged_indel_ins <-rbind(indel_ins_h453 %>%
                                 left_join(overlapped_indel_ins_reads %>%
                                       filter(!is.na(ID_h453)) %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_h453, commonID)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
                           dplyr::select(ID, start, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, indel_size, end) %>%
                           mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP H4-53"),
                   indel_ins_a630 %>%
                           right_join(overlapped_indel_ins_reads %>%
                                        filter(!is.na(ID_a630)) %>%
                                        dplyr::select(ID = ID_a630, commonID)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID)%>%
                     dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
                           dplyr::select(ID, start, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, indel_size, end)%>%
```

```{r}
del_len <- rbind(CpG_indel_del_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = indel_size) %>%
          mutate(type = "INDEL"),
      CpG_DEL_fisher%>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len) %>%
          mutate(type = "SV")) %>%
  mutate(Group = "Deletion") %>%
  rbind(rbind(CpG_indel_ins_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = indel_size) %>%
          mutate(type = "INDEL"),
        CpG_INS_fisher%>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len) %>%
          mutate(type = "SV")) %>%
          mutate(Group = "Insertion")) %>%
  rbind(CpG_DUP_fisher%>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len)%>%
          mutate(type = "SV", Group = "Duplication")) %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group),
         Sample =case_when(str_detect(ID, "_U$") ~"UWB1 BRCA1",
                           str_detect(ID, "_a630$") ~"OVCAR8 LP A6-30",
                           str_detect(ID, "_h453$") ~"OVCAR8 LP H4-53",
                           str_detect(ID, "_common$") ~"OVCAR8 common"),
                           Sample = factor(Sample),
         starting =if_else(Meth_ref/ (Meth_ref +Unmeth_ref) >= 0.8, "Ref Methylated", "Ref Unmethylated" ),
         starting = factor(starting, levels = c("Ref Methylated", "Ref Unmethylated")))  %>%
  group_by(ID, alt_len, Group, type, Sample, starting) %>%
  summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease" ,
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change")) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(changed = factor(changed, levels = c("Bi-Directional", "Increase", "Decrease", "No Change")))
```

```{r}
rbind(CpG_indel_del_fisher %>%

  mutate(Group = "Deletion",
         Sample =case_when(str_detect(ID, "_U$") ~"UWB1 BRCA1",
                           str_detect(ID, "_a630$") ~"OVCAR8 LP A6-30",
                           str_detect(ID, "_h453$") ~"OVCAR8 LP H4-53",
                           str_detect(ID, "_common$") ~"OVCAR8 common"),
         Sample = factor(Sample),
         starting =case_when(Meth_ref/ (Meth_ref +Unmeth_ref) >= 0.8 ~ "Ref Methylated",
                             Meth_ref/ (Meth_ref +Unmeth_ref) <= 0.2 ~ "Ref Unmethylated",
                             TRUE ~NA),
         starting = factor(starting, levels = c("Ref Methylated", "Ref Unmethylated")))  %>%

  group_by(ID,  Group, type, Sample, starting) %>%
  summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease",
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(type, Sample, changed, starting) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(changed = factor(changed, levels = c("Bi-Directional", "Increase", "Decrease", 
                                              "No Change")))  %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = type, fill = changed, y = count))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black")+
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("N= ", count)),
             position=  position_fill(vjust = 0.5))+
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Sample), rows = vars(starting))+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Duplication")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_change_palette, "CpG changed (N>=1)", limits = force)+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "Event with methylation change")+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())+
  ggtitle("Translocation")

ggsave("plots/breakdown_translocation_type_dir.pdf", width = 7, height =4)
```

##CGI

```{r}
isl_annot <- fread("ref/cpg_islands_ucsc.bed") %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd) 

isl_complete <- isl_annot %>%
  mutate(type = "Island")  %>%
  rbind(., isl_annot %>%mutate(chromEnd = chromStart, chromStart = chromStart - 2000,, type = "Shore")) %>%
  rbind(., isl_annot %>%mutate(chromStart = chromEnd, chromEnd = chromEnd + 2000,, type = "Shore")) %>%
  rbind(., isl_annot %>%mutate(chromEnd = chromStart- 2000, chromStart = chromStart - 4000,, type = "Shelf")) %>%
  rbind(., isl_annot %>%mutate(chromStart = chromEnd+2000, chromEnd = chromEnd + 4000,, type = "Shelf"))


alt_combined_annot <- alt_combined %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, bp = alt_start, ID, alt_type, changed, alt_len, starting) %>%
  left_join(isl_complete, by = join_by(chrom == chrom, bp <= chromEnd, bp >=chromStart)) %>%
    mutate(pos = "bp_1")%>%
  rbind(alt_combined %>%
          filter(alt_start != alt_end, !alt_type %in% c("BND", "INS")) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, bp = alt_end, ID, alt_type, changed, alt_len,  starting) %>%
  left_join(isl_complete, by = join_by(chrom == chrom, bp <= chromEnd, bp >=chromStart)) %>%
    mutate(pos = "bp_2")) %>%
  mutate(type = if_else(is.na(type), "OpenSea", type)) %>%
  group_by(chrom, bp, pos, ID, changed, alt_type, starting) %>%
  summarise(type = paste(unique(type), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(priority_type = case_when(str_detect(type, "Island") ~ "Island",
                                   str_detect(type, "Shore") ~ "Shore",
                                    str_detect(type, "Shelf") ~ "Shelf",
                                    TRUE~ "OpenSea"))

cgi_palette = c("Island" = "#C1A17A", "Shore" = "#EED7B5", "Shelf" = "#9AD3C2",
                "OpenSea" = "#A3C7E6")
alt_combined_annot %>%
  group_by(changed, priority_type, starting) %>%
  summarise(subtype_n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(priority_type = factor(priority_type, levels = c("Island", "Shore", "Shelf", "OpenSea")),
         changed = factor(changed)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = changed, y= subtype_n , fill = priority_type))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black")+
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("N=", subtype_n)), position =position_fill(vjust = 0.5) )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cgi_palette, "CGI Context")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "Sequence alteration breakpoints")+
  theme_bw()+
    facet_wrap(~starting, scales = "free_x")+
  xlab("From events with CpG changed (N>=1)")+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))
ggsave("plots/all_break_points_cgi_context.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)
```

```{r}
  full_join(alt_combined_annot_GENE %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom, bp, ID, changed, alt_type, alt_type, starting, gene_context = priority_type) ) %>%

         starting = factor(starting, levels = c("Ref Unmethylated", "Ref Methylated")),

         CGI = factor(CGI, levels = c("OpenSea", "Shelf", "Shore", "Island" )),
         rmsk = factor(rmsk, levels = c("NA", "DNA", "LTR", "SINE","LINE")))

summary(fit)
```

```{r}
#deletion
ovcar8_mod <- c("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/landing_pad_mapping/severus_a630/ovcar8_merged_SV_modkit_extract.tsv", "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/landing_pad_mapping/clair3/OVCAR8_merged_SV_modkit_extract.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x))

deletion <- alt_combined %>%
  filter(alt_type == "DEL", alt_len > 5, str_detect(SampleID, "OVCAR8"),
         str_detect(ID, "severus"))  %>%
  inner_join(ovcar8_mod %>%
              filter(mod_code == "m", base_qual >20) %>%
              mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position),
                     Meth = case_when(mod_qual >= 0.6 ~ "Me",
                         mod_qual <= 0.4 ~ "Un") ) %>%
              filter(!is.na(Meth)), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, alt_start <= ref_position, alt_end >= ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(chrom, alt_start, alt_end, alt_len, ID, changed, alt_type, SampleID, ref_position) %>%
  summarise(meth_perc = sum(Meth == "Me")/n()) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(relat_pos = (ref_position - alt_start)/ alt_len)

deletion$density <- get_density(deletion$relat_pos, deletion$meth_perc, n =40)

deletion%>%
  group_by(changed) %>%
  mutate(changed = paste0(changed, " (N=", n_distinct(ID), ")"),
         changed = factor(changed)) %>%
  mutate(changed = fct_rev(changed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(ID, changed) %>%
  summarise(med_meth = median(meth_perc)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = changed, y = med_meth, color = changed))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(  "#bb4430", "darkgrey"), "CpG changed (N>=1)")+
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 0.3, outlier.shape = NA)+
  stat_compare_means(aes(label = after_stat(p.signif)), comparisons = list(c("TRUE (N=12)", "FALSE (N=24)")))+
  geom_beeswarm()+
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
  inner_join(plot_DEL %>%
               dplyr::select(SV_start, SV_end, ID, chrom, SV_len,relat_pos, ref_position) %>%
               distinct()) %>%
  group_by(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end, SV_len) %>%
  mutate(side = if_else(relat_pos >0, "downstream of BP", "upstream of BP")) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  filter(sum(sig) ==0 | sig) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(SV_start, SV_end, ID, chrom, SV_len, side, changed) %>%
  filter(abs(relat_pos ) == min(abs(relat_pos)) )  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, changed, side, relat_pos, SV_start,SV_end) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "side", values_from = "relat_pos") %>%
  mutate( mid_point = (SV_start+SV_end)/2)


changed_dist_indel_del <-CpG_indel_del_fisher%>%
  filter(!(sig &diff >0)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease" ,
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change")) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(changed = factor(changed, levels = c("Bi-Directional", "Increase", "Decrease", "No Change"))) %>%
  inner_join(plot_indel_del %>%
               dplyr::select(start, end, ID, chrom, indel_size,relat_pos, ref_position) %>%
               distinct()) %>%
  group_by(ID, chrom, start, end, indel_size) %>%
  mutate(side = if_else(relat_pos >0, "downstream of BP", "upstream of BP")) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  filter(sum(sig) ==0 | sig) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(start, end, ID, chrom, indel_size, side, changed) %>%
  filter(abs(relat_pos ) == min(abs(relat_pos)) )  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, changed, side, relat_pos, start,end) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "side", values_from = "relat_pos") %>%
  mutate( mid_point = (start+end)/2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(SV_start = start, SV_end = end , SV_len = indel_size) %>%
  separate(ID, into = c("ID_1", "ID_2"), sep = ":") %>%
  separate(ID_2, into =c ("drop", "ID_2"),sep = "_") %>%
  dplyr::select(-drop) %>%
  unite(ID, ID_1:ID_2, sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(ID = paste0("indel_",ID))

                            str_detect(ID, "_U") ~ "UWB1_BRCA1")) %>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(range = list(GRanges(chrom, IRanges(start, end))))

         motif_start_relat = (start + motif_start-SV_start)/SV_len, motif_end_relat = (start + motif_start-SV_start +motif_width)/SV_len,
         motif_relat_pos = case_when(motif_start_relat <= 0 & motif_end_relat >=0 ~ 0.5, 
                                     motif_start_relat > 0 & motif_start_relat <1 & motif_end_relat >=1 ~ motif_start_relat,
                                    TRUE ~ (motif_start_relat + motif_end_relat) /2),
         type = if_else(str_detect(ID, "severus"), "SV", "INDEL")) %>%
```

#Deletion microhomology https://journals.plos.org/plosgenetics/article?id=10.1371/journal.pgen.1006368

https://github.com/Gaorav-Gupta-Lab/ScarMapper/blob/master/scarmapper/INDEL_Processing.py

```         
        The junction_type_data list contains the repair type category counts.  [0] TMEJ, del_size >= 4 and 
        microhomology_size >= 2; [1] NHEJ, del_size < 4 and ins_size < 5; [2] insertions >= 5 
        [3] Junctions with scars not represented by the other categories; [4] Non-MH Deletions, del_size >= 4 and 
        microhomology_size < 2 and ins_size < 5: [5] SNV, del_size > 1 and del_size == ins_size and 
        lft_del <= kmer_size and rt_del <= kmer_size
```

```{r}
get_match_matrix <- function(seqA, seqB, n) {
  basesA <- strsplit(seqA, "")[[1]]
  basesB <- rev(strsplit(seqB, "")[[1]])
  outer(basesA, basesB, Vectorize(function(a, b) as.integer(a == b)))
}
```

```{r}

# saveRDS(DEL_reads, "output/total_del_meth.RDS")

pdx_DEL_reads <- readRDS("output/total_del_meth.RDS")

non_overlapped_id <- pdx_DEL_reads %>%
  dplyr::select(SV_start, SV_end, chrom,ID, SampleID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(pdx_DEL_reads %>%
  dplyr::select(SV_start_2 = SV_start, SV_end_2 = SV_end, chrom,ID_2 = ID, SampleID)%>%
  distinct(),
   by = join_by(chrom == chrom, SampleID == SampleID, SV_start <=SV_end_2, SV_end >= SV_start_2)) %>%
  group_by(SV_start, SV_end, chrom,ID, SampleID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(ID_2) == 1)

pdx_del_meth <- pdx_DEL_reads %>%
  filter(ID %in% unlist(non_overlapped_id$ID)) %>%
  mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position-1, ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, read_type, ref_position, chrom, ID, SV_start, SV_end, SV_len) %>%
  summarise(Meth = sum(mod == 1), read_cnts = n(),
            Unmeth = read_cnts - Meth,
            meth_perc = Meth/read_cnts) %>%
  ungroup() 


PDX_DEL_fisher <-pdx_del_meth   %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, ID,SV_start, SV_end, ref_position,chrom, read_type, Meth, Unmeth, SV_len) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(SampleID, ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position,chrom, read_type,  SV_len) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(Meth, Unmeth),names_from = read_type)%>%
  distinct() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  filter(Meth_alt+Unmeth_alt >3, Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref>3, 
         Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref) >=0.8| Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref) <=0.2) %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position, SV_len, SampleID) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p.value =fisher.test(x = matrix(c(Meth_alt, Meth_ref, Unmeth_alt, Unmeth_ref),byrow = T, nrow = 2))$p.value ) %>%
  mutate(diff = Meth_alt/(Meth_alt+Unmeth_alt) -  Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(fisher.adj = p.adjust(p.value),
         sig = (fisher.adj <= 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.8 )) %>%
  ungroup()  


merged_DEL_simp <- PDX_DEL_fisher%>%
  group_by(SampleID, SV_len, ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end) %>%
  summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease" ,
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change"),
            changed_n = sum(sig),
            no_change_degree = max(abs(diff))) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(changed = factor(changed, levels = c("Bi-Directional", "Increase", "Decrease", "No Change"))) %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID =sample, alt_name)) %>%
  mutate(HR = if_else(SampleID %in% hom_me_list, "hom meBRCA1", "het meBRCA1")) %>%
  filter((changed == "No Change" & no_change_degree<= 0.2 )| (changed == "Decrease" & changed_n>=3))


merged_DEL_simp_meth_loss <- PDX_DEL_fisher%>%
  filter(Meth_ref / Unmeth_ref >= 0.8) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, SV_len, ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end) %>%
  summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease" ,
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change"),
            changed_n = sum(sig),
            no_change_degree = max(abs(diff))) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(changed = factor(changed, levels = c("Bi-Directional", "Increase", "Decrease", "No Change"))) %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID =sample, alt_name)) %>%
  mutate(HR = if_else(SampleID %in% hom_me_list, "hom meBRCA1", "het meBRCA1")) %>%
  filter((changed == "No Change" & no_change_degree<= 0.2 )| (changed == "Decrease" & changed_n>=3))
  
merged_DEL_simp_meth_loss%>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, SV_len, ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end, changed, changed_n, alt_name, HR) %>%
  distinct()


PDX_DEL_fisher %>%
  filter(SampleID != "SFRC01585S1_2163_T3") %>%
  group_by(SampleID, SV_len, ID) %>%
  summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease" ,
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change")) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(changed = factor(changed, levels = c("Bi-Directional", "Increase", "Decrease", "No Change"))) %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID =sample, alt_name)) %>%
  mutate(HR = if_else(SampleID %in% hom_me_list, "hom meBRCA1", "het meBRCA1")) %>%
  group_by(alt_name, changed, HR) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = alt_name, fill  = changed, y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~HR, scales = "free_x")+
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("N=", n)),
            position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_change_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
pdx_DEL_seq <- merged_DEL_simp %>% 
  filter(SV_len+40 <= 5000) %>%
  mutate(start = SV_start - 20, end = SV_end +20) %>%
  rbind(merged_DEL_simp %>% 
          filter(SV_len+40 > 5000,SV_len+40 <= 10000 ) %>%
          mutate(start = SV_start - 20, end = (SV_start+SV_end)/2,
                 ID = paste0(ID,"_u"))) %>%
  rbind(merged_DEL_simp %>% 
          filter(SV_len+40 > 5000,SV_len+40 <= 10000 ) %>%
          mutate(start = (SV_start+SV_end)/2+1, end = SV_end+20,
                 ID = paste0(ID,"_d"))) %>%
  rbind(merged_DEL_simp %>% 
          filter(SV_len+40 > 10000 ) %>%
          mutate(start = SV_start - 20, end = SV_start-20 +5000,
                 ID = paste0(ID,"_u"))) %>%
  rbind(merged_DEL_simp %>% 
          filter(SV_len+40 > 10000 ) %>%
          mutate(start = SV_end +20 - 5000, end = SV_end +20,
                 ID = paste0(ID,"_d")))%>%
  mutate(ID = paste0(ID, "_", gsub(" ", "", gsub("#", "", alt_name)))) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(range = list(GRanges(chrom, IRanges(start, end)))) %>%
  arrange(SampleID, ID)

_
```

##promoter gene body

```{r}
promoter <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/ref/EDPnew_20240409.bed")
gene_body <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/GSK_treated_OvCa/supporting/MANE.GRCh38.v1.3.ensembl_genomic_transcript.gtf") %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR =V1, chromStart = V4, chromEnd = V5)
gene_annotation <- rbind(promoter %>%
                           dplyr::select(chrom = `#chrom`, chromStart, chromEnd) %>%
                           mutate(type = "Promoter"),
                         gene_body %>%
                           dplyr::rename(chrom = CHR) %>%
                           mutate(type = "Gene Body"))

alt_combined_annot_GENE <- merged_DEL_simp%>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, SV_start, SV_end, ID,  changed_n, alt_len = SV_len) %>%
  left_join(gene_annotation, by = join_by(chrom == chrom, SV_start <= chromEnd, SV_end >=chromStart)) %>%
  mutate(type = if_else(is.na(type), "Intergenic", type)) %>%
  group_by(chrom, SV_start, SV_end, ID, changed_n) %>%
  summarise(type = paste(unique(type), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(priority_type = case_when(str_detect(type, "Promoter") ~ "Promoter",
                                   str_detect(type, "Gene Body") ~ "Gene Body",
                                    TRUE~ "Intergenic"))
  alt_combined_annot_GENE %>%
  mutate(changed  = changed_n >=1) %>%
  group_by(changed, priority_type) %>%
  summarise(subtype_n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(priority_type = factor(priority_type, levels = c("Promoter", "Gene Body", "Intergenic")),
         changed = factor(changed)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = changed, y= subtype_n , fill = priority_type))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black")+
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("N=", subtype_n)), position =position_fill(vjust = 0.5) )+
  scale_fill_manual(values =c("Promoter"= "#7d4f50", "Gene Body" = "#cc8b86", "Intergenic" ="#f9eae1"), "Gene Context")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "Sequence alteration breakpoints")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("From events with CpG changed (N>=1)")+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  ggsave("plots/all_break_points_gene_context.pdf", height = 5, width = 5.5)
  
  
  alt_combined_annot_GENE  %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(priority_type = factor(priority_type, levels = c("Promoter", "Gene Body", "Intergenic")),
         changed = factor(changed)) %>%
    filter(priority_type == "Promoter")
```

```{r}
SV_simp <-  rbind(
  CpG_indel_del_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = indel_size) %>%
        mutate(type = "indel", subtype = "del")%>%
          left_join(merged_indel_del %>%
                      dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start = start, SV_end = end) %>%
                      distinct()) ,
  CpG_DEL_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len) %>%
        mutate(type = "SV", subtype = "del")%>%
          left_join(merged_DEL %>%
                      dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end) %>%
                      distinct()) ,
  CpG_BND_fisher %>%
        mutate(type = "SV", subtype = "bnd",
               alt_len = 0)%>%
    dplyr::select(-chr_end) %>%
          left_join(merged_BND %>%
                      dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end) %>%
                      distinct()),
  CpG_DUP_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len) %>%
        mutate(type = "SV", subtype = "bnd")%>%
          left_join(merged_DUP %>%
                      dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end) %>%
                      distinct()),
  CpG_indel_ins_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = indel_size) %>%
        mutate(type = "indel", subtype = "ins")%>%
          left_join(merged_indel_ins %>%
                      dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start = start, SV_end = end) %>%
                      distinct()) ,
  CpG_INS_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len) %>%
        mutate(type = "SV", subtype = "ins")%>%
          left_join(merged_INS %>%
                      dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end) %>%
                      distinct())
  )%>%
          group_by(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end ,alt_len, ref_position, type, subtype) %>%
          mutate(changed = case_when( sig & diff >0 ~ "Increase",
                                      sig & diff <0 ~ "Decrease",
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change"))%>%
  ungroup()
```

## A630 - relative change in histone mod for ALT

```{r}
num_windows <- 10
window_size <-500

# Function to create 1kb windows around a variant
# Function to create windows around a variant

OVCAR8_SV_simp <-  SV_simp%>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(ID, "common") | str_detect(ID, "a630") |str_detect(ID, "h453"))

extended_df <- pmap_dfr(OVCAR8_SV_simp %>%
                          # filter(changed %in% c("No Change", "Decrease")) %>%
                          dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end, SV_type = subtype) %>%
                          distinct(), create_windows) %>%
  filter(!(SV_type == "bnd"  & abs(window_start- SV_end) < abs(window_start - SV_start)))


window_change_df <- extended_df %>%
  left_join(OVCAR8_SV_simp %>%
              dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, sig, type, subtype, changed,
                            Meth_ref, Unmeth_ref), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= ref_position, window_end >= ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, ref_position) %>%
  mutate(starting =if_else(Meth_ref/ (Meth_ref +Unmeth_ref) >= 0.8, "Ref Methylated", "Ref Unmethylated" ),
         starting = factor(starting, levels = c("Ref Methylated", "Ref Unmethylated"))) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, type, subtype, changed, starting) %>%
  summarise(sig = sum(sig), type = unique(type)) %>%
  ungroup()


window_histone <- window_change_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(sig)) %>%
  left_join(ovcar8_k9me3_overlap %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom =seqnames, start, end), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= end, window_end >= start))%>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, type, subtype, changed, sig ,starting) %>%
  summarise(H3K27me3_o = sum(!is.na(start))>0) %>%
  left_join(ovcar8_k4me3_overlap %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom =seqnames, start, end), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= end, window_end >= start)) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, type,subtype, changed, sig, starting, H3K27me3_o) %>%
  summarise(H3K4me3_o = sum(!is.na(start))>0) %>%
  left_join(ovcar8_k4me1_overlap %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom =seqnames, start, end), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= end, window_end >= start)) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, type, subtype, changed, sig, starting, H3K27me3_o, H3K4me3_o) %>%
  summarise(H3K4me1_o = sum(!is.na(start))>0)%>%
  left_join(ovcar8_k9me3_overlap %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom =seqnames, start, end), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= end, window_end >= start)) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, type, changed, subtype, sig, starting, H3K27me3_o, H3K4me3_o, H3K4me1_o) %>%
  summarise(H3K9me3_o = sum(!is.na(start))>0) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(mod_o = if_else(H3K27me3_o == H3K4me3_o, H3K4me3_o+H3K4me1_o-H3K9me3_o, H3K4me3_o+H3K4me1_o -H3K27me3_o-H3K9me3_o))

window_histone %>%
  filter(starting == "Ref Methylated") %>%
  mutate(mod_o_cat = case_when(mod_o < 0 & !H3K4me3_o & !H3K4me1_o~ "Repressive",
                           !H3K4me3_o & !H3K4me1_o & !H3K9me3_o & !H3K27me3_o ~ "Unknown Histone Mod",
                           mod_o > 0 & !H3K9me3_o & !H3K27me3_o~ "Activating",
                           TRUE ~"Bivalent"),
                           Meth_change = if_else(sig >0 , changed, "No Change"),
         Meth_change = factor(Meth_change, levels = c("No Change", "Increase", "Decrease")),
        mod_o_cat = factor(mod_o_cat, levels = c("Repressive",  "Activating", "Unknown Histone Mod", "Bivalent"))) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(mod_o_cat, Meth_change, starting) %>%
  summarise(n = n())%>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(mod_o_cat,  starting) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n), perc = n/total) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(mod_o_cat != "Unknown Histone Mod") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mod_o_cat , y = perc, fill = Meth_change))+
   geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_bw()+
  # coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,0.2))+
  geom_text(aes(label =paste0("N=", n)), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5))+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_change_palette, "Methylation Change")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,  "Methylation Changes within 50bp Window")+
  xlab("Parental Cell-line Histone Mod (50bp window)")+
  ggtitle("OVCAR8 A6-meth and H4-KO")+
    facet_wrap(~starting, scales = "free_y")
ggsave("plots/histone_with_del_ovcar8_cat.pdf", height = 5, width = 6)
```

#permutation for breakpoint overlapped with repressive markers

```{r}
OVCAR8_SV_simp  <-  SV_simp%>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(ID, "common") | str_detect(ID, "a630") |str_detect(ID, "h453")) %>%
                          dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end) %>%
                          distinct()

breakpoints <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
  OVCAR8_SV_simp,
  seqnames.field = "chrom",
  start.field = "SV_start",
  end.field = "SV_start",  # same as start for points
  ignore.strand = TRUE
)

ovcar8_pooled_rep_gr <- reduce(c(keep_bigger_overlaps(ovcar8_pooled_k9me3_gr, ovcar8_pooled_k9me3_rep_gr), 
                                 keep_bigger_overlaps(ovcar8_pooled_k27me3_gr, ovcar8_pooled_k27me3_rep_gr)))
ovcar8_pooled_act_gr <- reduce(c(keep_bigger_overlaps(ovcar8_pooled_k4me3_gr, ovcar8_pooled_k4me3_rep_gr),
                                 keep_bigger_overlaps(ovcar8_pooled_k4me1_gr, ovcar8_pooled_k4me1_rep_gr)))

overlap_hits <- findOverlaps(ovcar8_pooled_rep_gr, ovcar8_pooled_act_gr)

strict_repressive <-ovcar8_pooled_rep_gr[-unique(queryHits(overlap_hits))]
strict_activating <- ovcar8_pooled_act_gr[-unique(queryHits(overlap_hits))]
library(regioneR)

overlap_info <- overlapRegions(breakpoints, strict_repressive )

num_overlaps <- numOverlaps(breakpoints, strict_repressive)
cat("Number of overlaps with repressive markers:", num_overlaps, "\n")

num_overlaps <- numOverlaps(breakpoints, strict_activating)
cat("Number of overlaps with activating markers:", num_overlaps, "\n")


set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
pt <- permTest(A = breakpoints,
               B = strict_repressive,
               ntimes = 1000,
               randomize.function = randomizeRegions,
               evaluate.function = numOverlaps)

summary(pt)
plot(pt)
```

```{r}
extended_df <- pmap_dfr(UWB1_SV_simp %>%
                         dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end, SV_type = subtype) %>%
                          distinct(), create_windows) %>%
  filter(!(SV_type == "bnd"  & abs(window_start- SV_end) < abs(window_start - SV_start)))


window_change_df <- extended_df %>%
  left_join(UWB1_SV_simp %>%
              dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, sig, type, subtype, changed,
                            Meth_ref, Unmeth_ref), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= ref_position, window_end >= ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, ref_position) %>%
  mutate(starting =if_else(Meth_ref/ (Meth_ref +Unmeth_ref) >= 0.7, "Ref Methylated", "Ref Unmethylated" ),
         starting = factor(starting, levels = c("Ref Methylated", "Ref Unmethylated"))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, type, subtype, changed, starting) %>%
  summarise(sig = sum(sig), type = unique(type)) %>%
  ungroup()


window_histone <- window_change_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(sig)) %>%
  left_join(uwb1_pooled_k27me3 %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom =V1, start = V2, end = V3), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= end, window_end >= start))%>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, type, subtype, changed, sig, starting ) %>%
  summarise(H3K27me3_u = sum(!is.na(start))>0) %>%
  left_join(uwb1_pooled_k4me3 %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom =V1, start = V2, end = V3), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= end, window_end >= start)) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, type, subtype, changed, sig, starting, H3K27me3_u) %>%
  summarise(H3K4me3_u = sum(!is.na(start))>0) %>%
  left_join(uwb1_pooled_k4me1 %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom =V1, start = V2, end = V3), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= end, window_end >= start)) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, type, subtype, changed, sig, starting, H3K27me3_u, H3K4me3_u) %>%
  summarise(H3K4me1_u = sum(!is.na(start))>0)%>%
  left_join(uwb1_pooled_k9me3 %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom =V1, start = V2, end = V3), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= end, window_end >= start)) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, type, subtype, changed, sig, starting, H3K27me3_u, H3K4me3_u, H3K4me1_u) %>%
  summarise(H3K9me3_u = sum(!is.na(start))>0) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(mod_u = if_else(H3K27me3_u == H3K4me3_u, H3K4me3_u+H3K4me1_u-H3K9me3_u, H3K4me3_u+H3K4me1_u -H3K27me3_u-H3K9me3_u))

#UWB1

window_histone  %>%
  filter(starting == "Ref Methylated") %>%
  mutate(mod_u_cat = case_when(mod_u < 0 & !H3K4me3_u & !H3K4me1_u~ "Repressive",
                           !H3K4me3_u & !H3K4me1_u & !H3K9me3_u & !H3K27me3_u ~ "Unknown Histone Mod",
                           mod_u > 0 & !H3K9me3_u & !H3K27me3_u~ "Activating",
                           TRUE ~"Bivalent"),
         mod_u_cat = factor(mod_u_cat, levels = c("Repressive", "Activating", "Unknown Histone Mod", "Bivalent")),
         Meth_change = if_else(sig >0, changed, "No Change"),
         Meth_change = factor(Meth_change, levels = c("No Change", "Increase", "Decrease"))) %>%
  group_by(mod_u_cat, Meth_change, starting) %>%
  summarise(n = n())%>%
  ungroup() %>%
   group_by(mod_u_cat,  starting) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n), perc = n/total) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(mod_u_cat != "Unknown Histone Mod") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mod_u_cat , y = perc, fill = Meth_change))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_bw()+
  geom_text(aes(label =paste0("N=", n)), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5))+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,  "Methylation Changes within 50bp Window",)+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_change_palette, "Methylation Change")+
  xlab("Parental Cell-line Histone Mod (50bp window)")+
  facet_wrap(~ starting)+
  ggtitle("UWB1")
ggsave("plots/histone_with_del_uwb1_cat.pdf", height = 5, width = 6)
```

```{r}
  summarise(H3K4me3 = sum(!is.na(start))>0) %>%
  left_join(ovcar8_pooled_k4me1 %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom =V1, start = V2, end = V3), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= end, window_end >= start)) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, window_num, H3K27me3, H3K4me3) %>%
  summarise(H3K4me1 = sum(!is.na(start))>0)%>%
  left_join(ovcar8_pooled_k9me3 %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom =V1, start = V2, end = V3), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, window_start <= end, window_end >= start)) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, chrom, window_start, window_end, window_num, H3K27me3, H3K4me3, H3K4me1) %>%
  summarise(H3K9me3 = sum(!is.na(start))>0) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(mod = if_else(H3K27me3 == H3K4me3, H3K4me3+H3K4me1-H3K9me3, H3K4me3+H3K4me1 -H3K27me3-H3K9me3))
  # mutate(mod =as.numeric(H3K9me3))

mat <- alt_hist_mod %>%
  dplyr::select(variant_id, window_num, mod) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = window_num, values_from = mod) %>%
  left_join(A630_SV_simp %>%
              ungroup() %>%
              dplyr::select(variant_id = ID, changed) %>%
              distinct())   %>%
  column_to_rownames("variant_id")

hm <- Heatmap(mat %>%

clu_df %>%

  summarise( N= n())




A630_SV_simp <-  rbind(CpG_indel_del_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = indel_size) %>%
        mutate(type = "indel")%>%
          left_join(merged_indel_del %>%
                      dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start = start, SV_end = end) %>%
                      distinct()) %>%
          group_by(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end ,alt_len) %>%
          summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease" ,
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change")),
  CpG_DEL_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len) %>%
        mutate(type = "SV")%>%
          left_join(merged_DEL %>%
                      dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end) %>%
                      distinct()) %>%
          group_by(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end ,alt_len) %>%
  summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease" ,
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change")),
  CpG_indel_ins_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = indel_size) %>%
        mutate(type = "indel")%>%
          left_join(merged_indel_ins %>%

          group_by(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end ,alt_len) %>%
          summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease" ,
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change")),
  CpG_INS_fisher %>%

  summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease" ,
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change"))
  )%>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(ID, "common") | str_detect(ID, "a630"))
```
